children.summary: A custom AbilityBehaviour that's attached to the DeathShield ability so it functions with the API's shield logic changes.
This manager class handles the creation and management of mod-added abilities (sigils).
A utility class that holds all of the required information about an ability in order to be able to use it in-game.
Class for managing adding, retrieving, tracking custom cards added via the API.
Class for storing the data for custom portrait Sprites added via the API.
Class for managing special CardModificationInfos. These include persistent extended properties and custom costs.

A custom class implementing shield-giving behaviour. With the most recent API versions, shield-giving sigils like DeathShield/Nano Armour/ Armoured can now stack and instead use a counter rather than a simple boolean.
Class for handling exposing the bone-on-death behaviour present in the vanilla PlayableCard.Die method. Allows for modifying the default behaviour through Harmony patches.
This manager class handles the logic for shields.
This class handles the addition of new tribes into the game

The internal object used to store all relevant info about a Tribe. guid - The mod GUID that added the Tribe. name - The internal name of the Tribe. tribe - The enum value corresponding to this Tribe. icon - The sprite displayed on cards with this Tribe. tribeChoice - Whether or not this Tribe can appear at card tribe choice nodes. cardBack - The texture displayed at card tribe choice nodes. If null, the API will create one using the icon Sprite.
